original.target_description: Paper located and verified. Supplied locator does not identify one unique dependent measure/test among identification, gist, details, suppression contrasts and thought-control associations.

replication.target_description: Control participants only, details score: list by stimulus-set assignment interaction; group denotes set assignment, not PTSD status

n.quote: Confirmatory analysis was conducted with the 11 control participants from Round 1
n.exclusions: Excluded learning <60%, engagement <75%, or at least 6 consecutive blank/nonsense responses; probable PTSD participants not included

reported_success.quote: In summary, none of the dependent variables were shown to replicate the original study.

notes: Original paper is accessible, but locator is insufficient to choose a unique test. Replication PTSD-control exploratory analysis was not conducted because of insufficient probable PTSD sample. Extracted replication statistic explicitly describes located alternate test, with target_match false.
